example.title: Brenstrom farmstead, white barn, 10417 Westside Road

brief: White-painted gambrel barn about 34 ft wide and 50 ft long with a silver standing-seam metal roof, a hay hood at the gable peak over a loft door and small loft windows, and a squat square ventilator on the ridge. A lower white gable-roofed wing with a grey roof projects from the front as a calf and machinery shed. On the same farmstead stands an older weathered-grey gambrel barn with a long shed-roofed lean-to lined with small windows; dry grass lot and cornfields around.
